p.i: The words of both Alma and Amulek that were proclaimed to the people living in Ammonihah. In addition, they’re imprisoned and rescued by the miraculous power of God protecting them, according to Alma’s record.

chapter.li: LEChapter9 Verse1 I Alma was commanded by God to take Amulek and again preach to the people in Ammonihah. As I started to preach to them, they argued with me. They asked, VerseEnd Verse2 Who are 2PSI you? Do 2PP you think we’re going to believe one man’s testimony, even if he preached to us the earth would pass away? VerseEnd Verse3 Now they didn’t understand what they said, because they didn’t understand the earth will pass away. VerseEnd Verse4 They also said: We won’t believe 2PSI your words, even if 2PSI you were to prophesy this great city is going to be destroyed in a single day. VerseEnd Verse5 They didn’t believe God could do such miraculous things, because they were a hard-hearted and stubborn people. VerseEnd Verse6 And they asked: If it were actually true, why wouldn’t God send more authority than a single man to warn us about these important threats? VerseEnd Verse7 Then they started to arrest me, but hesitated.

I boldly stood my ground, fearlessly warning them: VerseEnd Verse8 2PP You wicked and corrupt generation! How have 2PP you abandoned the tradition of 2PP your forefathers? Yes, how have 2PP you so quickly discarded God’s commandments! VerseEnd Verse9 Don’t 2PP you remember God rescued our father Lehi from Jerusalem? Don’t 2PP you remember God led Lehi’s people through the wilderness? VerseEnd Verse10 Have 2PP you so soon forgotten the many times He rescued our forefathers from enemies and saved their lives, including at the hands of their own brothers? VerseEnd Verse11 If it hadn’t been for His unequaled power, mercy, and long-suffering toward us, we would certainly have vanished from the earth long before now. We may have been condemned to a state of endless misery, pain, and sorrow. VerseEnd Verse12 Now I tell 2PP you He commands 2PP you to repent. And unless 2PP you repent, there’s no way for 2PP you to inherit God’s kingdom. But this isn’t all. He’s commanded 2PP you to repent, or He’ll completely destroy 2PP you from off the earth. He’ll punish 2PP you in anger! He won’t end His fierce anger at 2PP you. VerseEnd

Verse13 Don’t 2PP you remember what He told Lehi: that to the degree 2PP you keep My commandments, 2PP you’ll prosper in the land. Also to the degree 2PP you don’t keep My commandments, 2PP you’ll be cut off from the Lord’s presence. VerseEnd Verse14 Now I want 2PP you to remember that the Lamanites haven’t kept God’s commandments, and they’ve been cut off from the Lord’s presence. Therefore the Lord’s word on this has been vindicated, and the Lamanites were cut off from His presence from the start of their rebellion. VerseEnd Verse15 Nevertheless, I warn 2PP you that they’ll be better off than 2PP you at judgment time if 2PP you remain in 2PP your sins. They’re even better off in this life than 2PP you, unless 2PP you repent. VerseEnd Verse16 Indeed, many promises have been given to the Lamanites, because they remain ignorant due to their ancestors’ traditions. Therefore the Lord will be merciful to them and patient with them living on the land. VerseEnd Verse17 At some time in the future, they’ll be taught to believe in His word and understand their ancestors’ traditions were wrong. Many of them will be saved because the Lord will forgive all those who call on His name. VerseEnd

Verse18 But I warn 2PP you if 2PP you persist in doing evil, 2PP your time on the land will end, because the Lamanites will attack 2PP you. If 2PP you don’t repent, they’ll come when 2PP you don’t expect it, and 2PP you’ll be punished and destroyed. It will be the result of the Lord’s fierce anger. VerseEnd Verse19 He won’t allow 2PP you to live in 2PP your iniquities, polluting His people. I tell 2PP you: No, He would choose to let the Lamanites destroy the entire Nephite nation if they were to fall into sin and transgression by rejecting so much light and knowledge given to them by the Lord their God. VerseEnd Verse20 2PP You’ve been a greatly blessed people by the Lord, more blessed than people of other nations, tribes, and languages. 2PP You’ve had things revealed to 2PP you about the past, present, and future. 2PP You’ve had 2PP your desires, faith, and prayers answered. VerseEnd Verse21 2PP You’ve been visited by the Spirit of God and heard the Lord’s voice speak to 2PP you. 2PP You’ve talked with angels and received the spirit of prophecy and revelation. 2PP You’ve been given many gifts: the gift of speaking in tongues, the gift of preaching, the gift of the Holy Ghost, and the gift of translation; VerseEnd Verse22 2PP you were rescued by God from the land of Jerusalem by His hand and then saved from famine, illness, and all kinds of diseases. The Nephites have been strengthened in battle so they couldn’t be killed and have been repeatedly freed from slavery and watched over and preserved until now. 2PP You’ve prospered until 2PP you’re now rich in many things. VerseEnd

Verse23 I warn 2PP you that if this people, who have received so many blessings from the Lord, were to sin against the light and knowledge they have, if 2PP you fall into transgression, then it will be far more bearable for the Lamanites than for 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse24 Indeed, the Lord’s promises are extended to the Lamanites, but if 2PP you sin they aren’t extended to 2PP you. Hasn’t the Lord expressly promised and firmly decreed that if 2PP you rebel against Him, 2PP you will be completely destroyed and removed from the earth? VerseEnd

Verse25 And now, to prevent 2PP you from being destroyed, the Lord has sent His angel to visit many of His people, instructing them to come and solemnly warn 2PP you: Repent! Repent, because the kingdom of heaven is coming soon. VerseEnd Verse26 Not many days from now the Son of God will come in His glory. His glory will be the glory of the Father’s Only Begotten: full of grace, fairness, truth, patience, mercy, and long-suffering, and quick to hear His people’s cries and answer their prayers. VerseEnd Verse27 He is coming to redeem those who are baptized as a sign of repentance, through faith in His name. VerseEnd Verse28 Therefore get ready for the coming Lord, because the time is near when everyone will reap a reward for their works based upon what they’ve been: If they’ve been righteous, they’ll receive salvation through the power and redemption of Jesus Christ. But if they’ve been evil, they’ll receive damnation through the power and captivity of the accuser. VerseEnd Verse29 This is the angel’s message to 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse30 Now, my cherished people (because 2PP you are my people and 2PP you should be cherished), 2PP you must produce evidence of 2PP your repentance, because 2PP your hearts remain hardened against God’s word, and 2PP you’re now a lost and fallen people. VerseEnd

Verse31 When I said this, the people were furious with me because I told them they were hard-hearted and stubborn. VerseEnd Verse32 And because I also told them they were a lost and fallen people, they were angry and tried to take me by force and throw me into prison. VerseEnd Verse33 But at that time the Lord didn’t let them throw me into prison. VerseEnd
Verse34 Then Amulek spoke up and also began to preach to them. Not everything Amulek said has been written, but some of his words are included below. VerseEnd
